notes.title: Major Update: Version 1.1, 28 new extremely difficult levels and UX update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, thank you for your support! We have currently sold about 100 copies of the game. This update will bring you 4 extremely difficult levels for each world, totaling 28 levels, along with UX updates.[/p][p]You can now see purple special levels on the map. Each map has 4 special levels, which will appear once the area is completed to a certain extent. The difficulty of the special levels will be extremely high, and it's estimated that each level after the third map will take about 8 minutes on average.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/c5709400fdb31688d34e96276542ebcd057b594c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/028291cfed8365fd68b533f8c6748876a7091f4a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]UX Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]When the mouse hovers over a house for a while, it will now show the connectable segments for that house, and the segments that are already connected will change color.[/p][/*][*][p]When the mouse hovers over a portal for a while, it will not only show the connectable segments but also change the segments connected to that portal to blue, while the segments connected to the exit portal will turn green. Segments that are not connected to the entry or exit portals will remain black.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/3c0fb9b388a883933206d8922220ff3c914041e7.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Light On Officially Released on Steam
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/2683d81f919962df4c32699cfbe5a5d4ca2825dc.png"][/img][/p][h2]Introduction[/h2][p]Exciting news for players who love cute cats and puzzle games! [i]Cat Engineer: Light On[/i] will officially launch on Steam on August 29, 2025. This game is meticulously crafted by the independent development team, Indigo Game Production. Featuring a unique hand-drawn art style, it takes players on a fantastical adventure around the globe, including locations like Hong Kong, Taiwan, and South Africa, bringing bright electricity to every corner. Successfully completing tasks will reward you with beautifully designed collectible art pieces that commemorate this wonderful journey.[/p][previewyoutube="-d0qOCS36mo;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Gameplay Overview[/h2][p]This game is based on the classic numerical logic puzzle game [i]Number Bridge[/i] and cleverly incorporates eight special items, making the gameplay more diverse and challenging. With a total of 120 levels, players will experience endless fun and excitement. The entire game features an innovative text-free design, allowing players to easily grasp the gameplay and item usage through exquisite level design and vivid visuals. In the later stages of the game, these eight special items will be cleverly combined, challenging your intellect and reaction skills.[/p][p]Additionally, a free update with 20 extra levels will be released in the future, making the exploration journey even more exciting. Join the ranks of the Cat Engineer, light up the world, and experience this creative and challenging adventure![/p]

notes.title: Major announcement! The game will be released on August 29 at 08:00 (UTC+0)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/2683d81f919962df4c32699cfbe5a5d4ca2825dc.png"][/img][/p][p]Major announcement! The game will be released on August 29 at 08:00 (UTC+0). We hope everyone will support us![/p][p]In the release version, there will be 7 different special tools, 140 unique levels, 7 maps from different countries, and 7 collections. The estimated playtime is over 10 hours.[/p][p]I hope everyone enjoys the game and learns the rules in a wordless world while going on adventures with the cute cats![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/274a972cf810b5ed34ad9b02a2abefb5b080f6df.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Major update to the demo version!!
notes.content:
The playtest version has been updated!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/3fe5316c952a0f8c438b806c0ec576c208afc7d0.png[/img]
Update Details:
Scene Update: The game scenes are now represented in a blueprint format, providing a warmer feel and making game items easier to access.
House Number Display: In addition to the required power in the center, the number of connected items will now be displayed in the top right corner.
Adjusted Difficulty Curve: The difficulty of the levels has been smoothed out for a better experience.
Current Levels: The playtest version now includes 30 levels, with 2 different special items available.
New Buttons:
R: Remove all lines
Z: Undo the last action
X: Redo the next action
hope you enjoy playing!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/2683d81f919962df4c32699cfbe5a5d4ca2825dc.png[/img]

notes.title: Do you like this new capsule
notes.content:
The logo now has a bloom effect and is more related to our game content, which includes tools, links, puzzles, and blueprint elements.

The background is cozier, cleaner, and features cats.

My game is a numerical puzzle game similar to Sudoku and Hashi. I am adding more elements and variations to make it more fun and cozy, not just numbers in the gameplay.

If you love my game, you can try our demo and wishlist it on Steam. I will keep you updated about this game. Thank you for loving my game!

Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2316640/Cat_Engineer_Light_On/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788912/c9ba6c7dd3e9fd396e5ef3383a333f291de67de4.png[/img]
